title: Isithembiso Esithethwe Ngamatye Amnyama
intro: Umi ecaleni komlilo wasentlango njengoko amalahle awo esasazwa ngononophelo. Iindwendwe zifika ukuze zihlangane ngoxolo, kwaye umyalezo omnye uvula ibali lesithembiso, ukumangaliswa, kunye nekamva elingekazaliseki.
clues: Sawela umgama ukuze sifikelele kwisicaka esithembekileyo entlango.
Sicele ukuba kusasazwe amalahle ukuze kulungiswe umlilo.
Sithethe nomnye owayebize ilangabi ukuba liphole kwaye likhuseleke.
Sizise iindaba zomntwana osandul’ ukuzalwa kumntu owayesele edlulile kwiminyaka yokuba nabantwana.
Umntwana othenjisiweyo simnike igama elithi Isaka.
Sizise iindaba ezimnandi zonyana ku-Ibrahim, kwaye ezo ndaba zimangalisayo zamshiya ehleka u-Ibrahim.
